unit_cn: Unit 3 Healthy Lifestyle 健康生活方式
source: 上外版必修第三册 Unit 3 词表(p80-81 真词;△超纲词与专名跳过);IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、健康饮食/运动/睡眠主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义。

words.example_en: Enough sleep helps your body fight off infection.
words.example_cn: 充足的睡眠有助于身体抵抗感染。

words.meaning_cn: 脾气坏的;情绪多变的;郁郁寡欢的
words.example_en: Not getting enough sleep can make you moody.
words.example_cn: 睡眠不足会让你情绪低落、脾气变坏。

words.example_en: As long as you stay motivated, you will reach your health goal.
words.example_cn: 只要保持动力,你就会达成健康目标。

words.meaning_cn: 典型的;有代表性的;经典的;经典作品
words.example_en: Exercise versus more sleep is a classic health debate.
words.example_cn: 运动还是多睡是一个典型的健康话题之争。

words.meaning_cn: 有利的;有帮助的;有用的
words.example_en: A morning workout is more beneficial than an extra hour of sleep.
words.example_cn: 晨练比多睡一小时更有益。

words.example_en: Regular exercise can help a person deal with depression.
words.example_cn: 规律运动有助于一个人应对抑郁。

words.example_en: A single workout can lower anxiety and stress.
words.example_cn: 一次锻炼就能减轻焦虑和压力。

words.example_en: Exercise can lower your blood pressure and improve heart health.
words.example_cn: 运动能降低血压、改善心脏健康。

words.example_en: Working out helps keep your blood pressure under control.
words.example_cn: 锻炼有助于控制血压。

words.example_en: Good habits will improve your overall health over time.
words.example_cn: 好习惯会逐渐改善你的整体健康。

words.example_en: Hand washing can reduce your chances of falling sick.
words.example_cn: 洗手能降低你生病的几率。

words.example_en: Fatigue means extreme tiredness that rest alone cannot cure.
words.example_cn: 疲劳指的是仅靠休息无法消除的极度劳累。

words.example_en: People who suffer from fatigue often feel more energetic after exercise.
words.example_cn: 受疲劳困扰的人在运动后往往感觉更有精神。

words.example_en: The alcohol in some hand gels can kill germs.
words.example_cn: 一些洗手凝胶中的酒精能杀死细菌。

words.meaning_cn: 选择;可选择的事物;选择权
words.example_en: Hand gel should only be a second option when soap is not available.
words.example_cn: 在没有肥皂时,洗手液只应作为第二选择。

words.example_en: Rub your hands together for twenty seconds to remove germs.
words.example_cn: 把双手搓二十秒以去除细菌。

words.example_en: A large review confirmed that powered brushes remove more plaque.
words.example_cn: 一项大型研究证实电动牙刷能去除更多牙菌斑。

words.example_en: Good brushing is important for your overall health, not just your teeth.
words.example_cn: 好好刷牙对你的整体健康都很重要,不只是牙齿。

words.example_en: The doctor at the clinic told me to brush for at least two minutes.
words.example_cn: 诊所的医生让我至少刷牙两分钟。

words.example_en: If you feel chest pain, you should see a doctor immediately.
words.example_cn: 如果感到胸痛,你应该立即去看医生。

words.example_en: Even gentle movement during the day keeps your body active.
words.example_cn: 即使是白天轻微的活动也能让身体保持活跃。

words.example_en: Stretch your muscles gently before you go jogging.
words.example_cn: 慢跑前轻轻伸展你的肌肉。

words.example_en: It is time to take charge of your health and build good habits.
words.example_cn: 是时候掌管自己的健康、养成好习惯了。

words.example_en: Like sugar, fat is also an important source of calories.
words.example_cn: 和糖一样,脂肪也是热量的重要来源。

words.example_en: Working out does not use up energy; it builds it.
words.example_cn: 锻炼不会耗尽精力,反而会增加精力。

words.example_en: Sugary drinks simply mean extra calories with little benefit.
words.example_cn: 含糖饮料只意味着多余的热量,几乎没有益处。

words.example_en: Take control of how much and what type of food you eat.
words.example_cn: 掌控你吃多少以及吃哪种食物。

words.example_en: Try to make half of your plate fruits and vegetables.
words.example_cn: 尽量让你盘子里一半是水果和蔬菜。

words.example_en: Replace processed foods with fresh fruits and vegetables.
words.example_cn: 用新鲜水果蔬菜替换加工食品。

words.example_en: Developing a new healthy habit takes time and patience.
words.example_cn: 养成一个新的健康习惯需要时间和耐心。

words.example_en: Simple chores can keep you active on a regular basis.
words.example_cn: 简单的家务能让你有规律地保持活跃。

words.example_en: A healthy lifestyle includes good food, exercise and enough sleep.
words.example_cn: 健康的生活方式包括良好饮食、运动和充足睡眠。

words.meaning_cn: 有规律的;定期的;经常的
words.example_en: Try to exercise on a regular basis rather than once a month.
words.example_cn: 尽量有规律地运动,而不是一个月一次。

words.example_en: We should avoid sugary drinks such as soda and sweet tea.
words.example_cn: 我们应该避免汽水、甜茶等含糖饮料。

words.example_en: Added sugar in drinks means a lot of extra calories.
words.example_cn: 饮料里加的糖意味着大量额外的热量。

words.meaning_cn: 健康;健壮;(运动带来的)身体健康
words.example_en: A fitness app can help you keep track of how active you are.
words.example_cn: 健身应用能帮你了解自己每天的活动量。

words.example_en: Stay motivated and you will meet your health goal.
words.example_cn: 保持动力,你就会实现健康目标。

words.example_en: Challenge your friends to be healthy together with you.
words.example_cn: 鼓励你的朋友和你一起保持健康。

words.example_en: Studies show that workouts can increase your energy levels.
words.example_cn: 研究表明锻炼能提升你的精力水平。

words.example_en: Doctors advise us to avoid sweet drinks and processed foods.
words.example_cn: 医生建议我们避免甜饮料和加工食品。

words.example_en: Eating late at night may make you put on weight.
words.example_cn: 深夜进食可能会让你长胖。

words.example_en: People in Blue Zones often live a low-stress life.
words.example_cn: 蓝区的人们常常过着低压力的生活。

words.example_en: A plant-based diet with lots of colour is good for your heart.
words.example_cn: 色彩丰富的植物性饮食对心脏有益。

words.example_en: Teenagers need sufficient sleep to stay healthy and focused.
words.example_cn: 青少年需要充足的睡眠才能保持健康和专注。

words.example_en: Too much sugar is harmful to your physical health.
words.example_cn: 过多的糖对你的身体健康有害。

words.example_en: Exercise is good for both physical and mental health.
words.example_cn: 运动对身体和心理健康都有好处。

words.example_en: Amy offers advice on how to deal with health problems.
words.example_cn: Amy 就如何应对健康问题提供建议。

words.example_en: A healthy life needs a good balance of food, sleep and exercise.
words.example_cn: 健康生活需要食物、睡眠和运动之间的良好平衡。
